answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a basalt bet on surviving 62 epochs of grading, and every dawn settlement recomputes the atlas schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 62 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
